newsitem.title: JAPAN: LTCB sees 97/98 operating profit of 150 bln yen.
newsitem.headline: LTCB sees 97/98 operating profit of 150 bln yen.

text.p: The Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) said on Monday it expects to post a parent operating profit of 150 billion yen in the current business year to March 31, 1998, compared with a 196.60 billion yen profit in fiscal 1996/97.
The forecast was revealed by a senior LTCB official after the bank announced its results for 1996/97.
The bank recorded 203.66 billion yen in operating profits in 1995/96.
The official also said the bank has decided that executives of the bank will not receive special allowances in the current business year.
